facts.text: The Englishman made his debut at The Open when it was last held at Royal Birkdale in 2017 but struggled during the early years of his journeyman career, working as a Morrisons delivery driver during Covid and as recently as 2024.

"Obviously it's a great opportunity to be able to play golf for a living and I'm really thankful for it." He was included in the Last-Chance Qualifier after narrowly missing out on a spot via Final Qualifying, with Wesley Bryan - a former PGA Tour player turned YouTube golfer - and ex-Amateur Champion Aldrich Potgieter among the others involved.

I don't know if I got used to it a bit more and it was sort of just a one-round shoot-out." Dean earned the win with fiancée Emily as caddie ahead of their wedding next Tuesday, with the victory following two top-10 finishes in their last three starts working together on the DP World Tour.
Expect to hear that song plenty from the record-breaking crowds heading to Royal Birkdale.
Here is all you need to know as players target a place in the third Major Championship of the season.
As with years gone by, Final Qualifying will attract Major champions, former Ryder Cup stars, winners on both the DP World Tour and PGA TOUR, along with rising global talent and seasoned campaigners.
Open will be held at Shinnecock Hills Golf Club from June 18–21, 2026.
The number of qualifying spots on offer will be announced ahead of play at the three sites on Monday, based on field strength and entry counts.
Following that, 13 venues, across three continents, will stage 36-hole Final Qualifying from May 18 to June 8 (often referred to as Golf's Longest Day).
A collective 60-70 spots are on offer from Final Qualifying.

The World Wide Technology Championship, set to tee off Thursday at El Cardonal at Diamante in Los Cabos, Mexico, offers the opportunity for four golfers to play their way into the FedExCup Fall event via an 18-hole qualifier on Monday.
